nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Generalized Additive Models for Location, Scale and Shape (GAMLSS) implemented with the R gamlss package.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: we implemented the Generalized Additive Models for Location, Scale, and Shape (GAMLSS) 80 using the gamlss package.

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: EEG spectral relative power (PSD-derived) and cortical source functional connectivity computed with amplitude envelope correlation (AEC).
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: The power spectrum density (PSD) for each epoch and each channel is computed using Welch ' s method (1-s Hann window with a 50% overlap, and a spectral resolution of 0.5 Hz). PSDs are then averaged across all epochs within a subject. Relative power in speci /uniFB01 c frequency bands (delta [1 -4 Hz], theta [4 -8 Hz], alpha [8 -13 Hz], beta [13 -30 Hz], gamma [30 -45 Hz]) is computed by dividing the absolute power within each narrow band by the total power of the broader band [1 -45 Hz].; Subsequently, we computed the functional connectivity between pairwise regions of interest, using the amplitude envelope correlation (AEC) method

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age is the main covariate; sex is included in the delta-band connectivity model (mu ~ fp(age, 1) + factor(sex)).
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: In this study, our response variable is an EEG-derived feature, and age serves as the main covariate. The inclusion of other covariates such as sex and data collection sites is detailed in subsequent sections.; mu | y ~ fp (age, 1) + factor (sex)
